name: N3cro's Player/AI Revive & Medical
author: N3cro
priority: 2 Complementary AI methods; existing Protocol/foundation priority unchanged
area: AI casualty aid, rescue, cover coordination and task handback
scope: PURELY AI features from the user-supplied list, rebuilt for dynamic AI use through existing CBE owners. AI may assist downed/wounded players and AI; this does not include player-facing medical controls or a replacement revive/medical framework. Select, combine, fix and improve useful methods, not a whole-mod port or competing controller.

requestedAIFeatures.intent: Eligible friendly AI autonomously assist downed players and AI. Prefer a qualified medic, then an actor with a First Aid Kit when the active medical rules permit. One reviver per casualty; exclude casualties being dragged or already receiving treatment.

Use threat, nearby friendly support and explicit task intent to choose a direct urgent approach, normal movement in quiet conditions, a covered rush with nearby support, or a cautious low approach when isolated under threat. Do not require pre-placed modules, scripted waypoints or hand-authored rescue routes.

When current threat makes treatment unsafe, use available smoke toward the known threat, coordinate eligible squad cover and physically move the casualty to reachable nearby tree/rock/wall/building cover before treatment. Never invent smoke, enemy knowledge, accessible cover or physical arrival.
AI treat wounded friendly players/AI and themselves when appropriate help is unavailable, using the active medical provider, actual supplies and bounded priorities.

Autonomous aid respects individual Stop/hold and newer mission/Zeus orders. A direct rescue task may temporarily leave a held position, then return to the captured still-owned position/order rather than erase hold state or regroup the whole group.

After aid or a finite rescue timeout, return to the original still-owned formation/task context. Release the casualty claim so another eligible helper can try; no indefinitely renewed timer, forced group reset or automatic wedge that overrides another active behaviour.

exclusions: Player-operated revive/heal/drag actions and player UI/HUD/menus/keybinds.
Replacement damage, unconsciousness, injury, respawn/revive rules or medical supplies economy.
Automatic installation of the entire source addon or duplicate permanent rescue/cover controllers.
integrationRequirements: Reconcile source implementation with current CBE danger/operation FSM, medical-task authority, movement/cover, communication, smoke/suppression and buddy/squad owners before changing production code.
Use bounded nearby discovery and credible casualty/threat knowledge. Support dynamically spawned AI and repeated casualties without a scenario-specific setup requirement.

Claim a casualty atomically on an explicit authority; authenticate treatment/drag requests to the current actor/casualty owner. Reconcile locality, HC and JIP without two revivers or duplicate handlers.

Respect existing medical providers, mission-authored injury/revive rules, skill baselines, player/specialist treatment ownership and actual inventory. Establish vanilla/ACE/API boundaries during review; do not assume compatible treatment or force a successful revive.
Hold/Stop is authoritative for autonomous aid. Explicit rescue permission is task-scoped; restore the original held position or task only if still owned, and yield immediately to newer orders.

Keep original rescue/approach/treatment deadlines and finite retries. On death, deletion, unavailable path/cover, dragging, treatment takeover or order replacement, release only owned claims, smoke/cover roles and movement state.
Use real physical casualty movement and credible animations/grip, with no arm stretching, teleport recovery, simulation/damage shortcuts, free smoke or invented treatment completion.
Record build-out, offline checks, physical assistance/repeat/cleanup evidence and measured performance separately. Audits and the full implementation goal remain paused.
identityEvidence: User URL and supplied AI feature list; installed mod.cpp/meta.cpp with matching publishedid and package hashes. Workshop open failed and search did not identify the item. No extracted-code review, source execution or behaviour verification.
dependencies: UNVERIFIED; inspect config/source and actual medical-provider APIs before integration.
licence: UNVERIFIED; inspect source/component reuse rights. Independently implement selected intent unless permission permits reuse.
sourceReview: NOT_STARTED; user-supplied requested scope and local metadata/package inventory only.
ordering: Foundations first; integrate individual aid/movement and task custody before composing rescue pairs and squad cover. Existing Protocol priority remains. Compatibility-only sources remain deferred.
sourceProtection: Installed Workshop originals, archives, game addons and signing files remain read-only; no raw source/assets/secrets in Git or product packages. Future extraction must use a separate private dated working directory.
